    - "Index manager has addChild, removeChild, getChildren for childrenOf map management"

    - "Auth reads AGENTACK_USER_TOKEN env var; tokens are tk_ + 8 random alphanumeric chars"
    - "Users register is bootstrap (no auth required); list requires read auth; revoke/regenerate require write auth"
    - "Token regeneration is self-service only (caller must be the target user)"
    - "Hierarchy module (hierarchy.ts): pure functions — isStatusAfter, validateNewChild, validateParentStatusChange, getClosableChildren, computeUpwardPromotions"
    - "Issue create() validates parentId: parent must exist, not be closed, child added to childrenOf map"
    - "Issue update() handles downward cascade (auto-close done children when parent closes), upward auto-promotion (child advancing past parent promotes recursively), reparenting (changing parentId with constraint checks)"
    - "Status ordering: open < in-progress < done < closed; closed items cannot have children added"
    - "Dependency manager: readDependencies/writeDependencies for dependencies.json persistence"
    - "Blockage operations: addBlockage (appends BlockageAddedEvent to issue events + writes dependencies.json), resolveBlockage (appends BlockageResolvedEvent), deleteBlockage (appends BlockageDeletedEvent)"
    - "getImpactScore(blockedIssueId) — recursive BFS counting all transitively blocked issues (via children hierarchy), returns count"
    - "detectCycle(sourceId, targetId, deps) — DFS from targetId through blockedBy edges, returns true if path reaches sourceId"
    - "blockagesAdd supports batch: multiple blockages in one call, with single cycle-check pass over accumulated proposed edges"
    - "Auto-resolution: tracker.update() auto-resolves blockages when an issue transitions to done/closed status"
    - "List sort uses impact score as tiebreaker (higher impact = earlier in list)"
    - "readDependenciesSync(trackerDir) — private sync helper in tracker.ts, reads dependencies.json synchronously via readFileSync; needed inside sort comparators where async is not possible"

    - "list — options: --status, --assignee, --tags (comma-sep), --parentId ('null' for top-level)"
    - "view <issueId> — shows full computed state"
    - "update <issueId> — options: --title, --description, --status, --assignee, --tags, --priority, --parentId ('null' to detach)"
    - "history <issueId> — shows raw event array"
    - "users register <name> — registers a new user"
    - "users list — lists registered users (tokens stripped)"
    - "users revoke <name> — removes a user"
    - "users regenerate <name> — regenerates token (self-service only)"
    - "comments add <issueId> <content> — adds a comment to an issue"
    - "comments update <issueId> <commentId> <content> — updates a comment's content"
    - "comments delete <issueId> <commentId> — soft-deletes a comment"
    - "comments list <issueId> — lists all comments on an issue"
    - "blockages add <issueId> <blockedById> — adds a blockage (issue blocked by another); supports --reason option"
    - "blockages resolve <issueId> <blockedById> — resolves a blockage"
    - "blockages delete <issueId> <blockedById> — deletes a blockage"
    - "blockages list <issueId> — lists all blockages on an issue"
    - "next <userName> — recommends the next issue to work on for a user (no options)"
    - "push — syncs agentrack data to remote; option: --message <string> to override auto-generated commit message"
    - "pull — syncs agentrack data from remote"
    - "push/pull are NOT Tracker methods — they are standalone worktree module functions (pushWorktree/pullWorktree exported from src/core/worktree.ts)"

(4) Package config — prepublishOnly script, package.test.ts (3 tests). 549 tests, 1948 assertions total. All implementation phases done."
    phase_8: "COMPLETE — build pipeline. (1) tsup v8.5.1 installed as devDependency. (2) tsup.config.ts with two entry points: library (ESM+CJS+dts, commander external) and CLI binary (bundled, node shebang via banner). (3) package.json updated: main→dist/index.cjs, module→dist/index.js, types→dist/index.d.ts, dual exports with types conditions, bin→dist/bin.js, files→dist/, engines→node>=20, added build script. (4) Removed hardcoded shebang from bin.ts (tsup banner handles it). (5) Node.js compat audit: no Bun-specific APIs — codebase uses node:fs/promises. (6) Build produces: dist/index.js (ESM), dist/index.cjs (CJS), dist/index.d.ts, dist/index.d.cts, dist/bin.js + sourcemaps. (7) All quality gates pass: 549 tests, 1950 assertions. (8) Verified: CJS import, ESM import, CLI binary --help/--version all work."
    next_command: "COMPLETE — `next <userName>` command. (1) NextResult type in src/types/api.ts — ComputedIssue | {result, message} discriminated union. (2) Tracker.next(assignee) in src/core/tracker.ts — validates init + read auth, filters index.open by assignee + actionable statuses (idea/todo/in-progress), excludes issues with active blockages, sorts by priority ASC → impact DESC → id ASC, replays events and returns top ComputedIssue. Returns NO_ISSUES_AVAILABLE if no candidates. (3) readDependenciesSync() private helper in tracker.ts — sync file read for use inside sort comparator. (4) CLI: src/cli/commands/next.ts (nextAction handler), registered in runner.ts as `next <userName>`. (5) Exported NextResult from barrel (src/index.ts, src/types/index.ts)."
    next_todo_only_spec_review: "REVIEWED — Spec proposes changing Tracker.next() to only consider todo status (removing idea and in-progress). Core change is 1 line (status filter array at tracker.ts:546) + 1 line (NO_ISSUES_AVAILABLE message). Key findings: (1) ~11 tests will break because they create issues without status (defaults to idea), (2) one test explicitly validates 3-status inclusion and needs full rewrite, (3) message should say 'No unblocked todo issues found' to capture both status AND blockage dimensions, (4) behavioral breaking change for users relying on next to surface idea/in-progress items, (5) default create status is idea so newly-created issues won't appear in next until moved to todo."
    cap_upward_promotion_spec_review: "REVIEWED — Spec proposes capping upward auto-promotion at in-progress so parents are never auto-promoted to done/closed. Core change: computeUpwardPromotions in hierarchy.ts (~5 lines), compute a capped status before the while-loop. Key findings: (1) Reparenting code path also affected (same function used) — not explicitly mentioned in spec, (2) reason message format for capped promotions needs spec clarification, (3) when parent is already at in-progress and child goes to done, NO promotion event emitted (capped status equals current, isStatusAfter returns false), (4) 7 tests need updating across hierarchy.test.ts and tracker-hierarchy test files, (5) no changes needed to any other module, risk is low."
    independent_git_spec_review: "REVIEWED — Spec proposes storing .agentrack/ data on a dedicated orphan branch (_agentrack) mounted as git worktree, with agt init/push/pull commands for setup and sync. Critical findings: (1) Git plumbing initial files in spec have WRONG data formats (config has version field + missing defaultUser, index uses issues[] instead of open/closed arrays, deps uses different key names) — will cause all reads to fail. (2) Tracker.init() ordering bug — spec mounts worktree first then calls tracker.init(), but init() has existsSync check that returns ALREADY_INITIALIZED without creating files; AC7 claim 'no changes to Tracker' is inaccurate. (3) Wrong file paths: spec says src/errors.ts (actual: src/core/errors.ts) and src/runner.ts (actual: src/cli/runner.ts). (4) .gitignore auto-commit on user's branch is surprising behavior. (5) Missing: exit codes for 5 new error codes, public API exports for new types. (6) Edge cases: race condition in concurrent init (both detect 'fresh'), pre-existing local _agentrack branch not in error table, gitignore check too strict. Architecture is sound — worktree isolation is the right approach, but critical issues must be fixed before implementation."
    user_docs_spec_review: "REVIEWED — Spec proposes replacing TypeDoc with hand-written user docs in docs/markdown/ (8 files). Key findings: (1) CRITICAL: Section 3h JavaScript API has ALL method names wrong — spec uses verb-first (addComment, listBlockages) but actual Tracker uses domain-first (commentsAdd, blockagesList). 12 methods affected. (2) CRITICAL: create() signature wrong — spec says create(title, options?) but actual is create(params: CreateParams) single-object pattern. (3) CRITICAL: push()/pull() are NOT Tracker methods — they are standalone worktree module functions (pushWorktree/pullWorktree). (4) Type names wrong: CreateIssueOptions→CreateParams, UpdateIssueOptions→UpdateParams, ListFilters→ListParams. (5) CLI --by flag is variadic (--by <ids...>), not singular. (6) Missing push --message flag in CLI reference. (7) Spec lists 9 types but API exports 40+. Structural plan (TypeDoc removal, 8-section layout, file cleanup) is sound. Auth, issue-object, hierarchy sections are accurate."
